rows.name: 2026 standings reconciliation
rows.detail: W, L, T, PF and PA recomputed from the third-party game log for all 32 teams and compared with the official NFL.com league standings page.

rows.name: Look-ahead integrity test
rows.detail: The outcome of all 422 holdout games was shifted by 7 points and the forecast engine re-run.
rows.detail_value: 0 forecasts made before the holdout changed

rows.name: Spread line convention
rows.detail: The archive's spread_line was tested against the actual margin under both possible readings and against the archive's own moneyline signs.
rows.detail_value: Adopted reading (the home line is -spread_line) gives a 60.14% home cover rate over 7413 rows; the rejected reading gives 48.96%. The moneyline cross-check agrees with the adopted reading in 99.39% of 5432 games.

rows.name: League totals balance
rows.detail: Points for and points allowed summed over every 2026 game must be equal.

rows.name: Tied games handled
rows.detail: The 2026 season contains one tied game. Ties must be a push for spread, total and moneyline bets, never a win.

rows.name: Own line coverage of the Week 10 slate
rows.detail: Every scheduled Week 10 game must have an own line.
